data.answer: Production access is just-in-time and a grant lasts a maximum of 8 hours before expiring automatically. Interns are not eligible for production access. Staff access is limited to support and operations needs under the access control policy.

Customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) are not supported in the current product, and all keys are managed by Nimbus Labs through AWS KMS. Production runs in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) with a cross-region replica maintained in Singapore (ap-southeast-1).
Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report. It does not yet hold ISO 27001 certification; certification is planned for 2027.
